name: alienx-smarthome
description: Public-facing technology showcase for AlienX SmartHome.

scripts.build: node scripts/write-release.mjs && node scripts/optimize-images.mjs && astro build
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run security:audit && npm run security:history && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:target && npm run typecheck && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy: node scripts/verify-ci.mjs && node scripts/verify-deploy-target.mjs && wrangler deploy
scripts.dev: node scripts/write-release.mjs && node scripts/optimize-images.mjs && astro dev
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler dev --host 127.0.0.1 --upstream-protocol http
scripts.format: prettier --write src public scripts tests .github "*.md" "docs/*.md" "*.config.*" package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src public scripts tests .github "*.md" "docs/*.md" "*.config.*" package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.preflight: npm run check && npm run audit
